delivery: Unreleased source prototype; no version bump, commit, push, installer or installation in this turn.
scope: Pure Rust sceneComposition.expand on protocol 1 with optional feature version 1; native and WASM share one implementation.
Single-file recipe v1 with fragments, repeated placements, explicit stable local-key to UUID maps, organizational groups, isolated field overrides and positional offset.
Ordinary Scene2D v3 output and separate JSON Pointer contributor map; CLI bundle also binds the raw UTF-8 source SHA-256.
Read-only bounded Node CLI; generated scene enters existing scene.create, model, runtime2, resource-package, full archive and Godot paths in synthetic workspaces.

reviewFix.finding: A sourceMap contributor pointer could exist in the recipe while belonging to another actor, field or placement; a malformed ABI response was accepted. The production Rust response itself was correct.
reviewFix.change: The JS boundary now validates exact contributor paths and order for the current template, actor override, placement offset and group membership/parent. Value expansion remains in Rust.

limits: Experimental CLI/engine entry only: no recipe GUI, registered recipe object, dependency closure or automatic recipe backup.
Generated scenes can be edited normally, but edits do not update the recipe; re-expansion does not merge later baked-scene edits.
No nested/cross-file fragments, arbitrary expressions/scripts, spatial group transforms or multi-file transactions; existing 128 actor/group bounds remain.
SourceMap provides contributor JSON Pointers, not exact writable source spans or World write authority.
No new browser UI, Tauri window, installer or Android device acceptance; prior reports retain their original conditions.
